title: Breakout fading: a THEN box
intro_say: Angstrom Signals. | Worked example: a breakout that fades.
outro_say: One idea, written down in order. | Descriptive readings, not advice.

steps.screen: The idea as a card: first a breakout on heavy volume, then the volume drops away within 5 days
steps.say: Some ideas happen in order. | First, price breaks out on heavy volume. | Then, within a few days, the volume dries up.

steps.screen: Set editor: add the Recent structure break Group and the Relative volume signal
steps.say: Add the Recent structure break Group, and the relative volume signal.

steps.screen: + ⏭ THEN box: First, Then within, Cancel if
steps.say: Then add a THEN box. | It has a First part, a Then part with a number of days, and an optional Cancel.

steps.screen: 1 · First: an upward break is met, and relative volume is at least 1.5
steps.say: First: an upward break, | on at least one and a half times the usual volume.

steps.screen: 2 · Then, within 5 daily closes: relative volume is at most 1.5
steps.say: Then, within five daily closes: volume is back below one and a half times usual.

steps.screen: The sentence the editor writes under it
steps.say: The editor writes it out in plain words. | First and Then on the same day don't count: Then has to come later.

steps.screen: Save; Prism: run it on All crypto at a past moment
steps.say: Save it, and run it on your coins at a past moment.

steps.screen: Results, with ⏭ marks beside some No answers
steps.say: Yes means both steps happened, in order. | A No with a skip mark is part-way: the breakout happened, and the drop can still come in time.
To see whether anything usually followed, | open the Set and tap Study this Set.
